description: This file defines the PdfImage class, part of the PdfSharp library, responsible for handling image data within PDFs. It includes methods for initializing images from various sources, supporting different formats like JPEG, PNG, GIF, TIFF, and custom bitmap data. The class handles image encoding, compression, and integration into the PDF structure, including color space considerations and supporting image masks and transparency. It also contains logic for reading and processing image data from GDI+ and WPF images, adapting to different pixel formats and image properties.

classes.name: PdfImage
classes.description: Represents an image object in a PDF document, capable of initializing from various image sources, encoding the image data, and embedding it into the PDF with appropriate compression and color space handling.

methods.name: PdfImage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a PdfImage from an XImage object, determines the image format, and initializes the image data accordingly.

methods.name: Image
methods.description: Property to access the underlying XImage object.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, in this case 'Image'.

methods.name: InitializeJpeg
methods.description: Prepares the image data stream and PDF dictionary entries for JPEG images, including compression and filters.

methods.name: InitializeNonJpeg
methods.description: Prepares the image data for non-JPEG images, supporting formats like PNG, GIF, TIFF, and bitmaps, with appropriate encoding and color space settings.

methods.name: CreateTrueColorMemoryBitmap
methods.description: Generates a PDF image dictionary for true color bitmaps (RGB or ARGB), handling masks and alpha transparency.

methods.name: CreateIndexedMemoryBitmap
methods.description: Creates an indexed color image stream for palette-based images, including handling masks and transparency levels.

methods.name: ReadTrueColorMemoryBitmap
methods.description: Reads image data from GDI+ or WPF images and converts them into a suitable bitmap format for PDF embedding.

methods.name: ReadIndexedMemoryBitmap
methods.description: Reads indexed bitmap data, including palette and transparency masks, from GDI+ or WPF images.
